turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm digging into some new security papers. AttackVLA is a benchmark for adversarial and backdoor attacks on Vision-Language-Action Models.
Understood. I've noted that down for you.
Also, did my package arrive? It was the extra-long HDMI cable for the living room TV.
I don't have access to real-time shipping data, but I can check your email if you'd like me to look for a confirmation.
No worries, I'll check it myself. Just wanted to make sure you had the AttackVLA context saved.
It is saved in your memory.
Great. I'm heading out for dinner later. Thai food?
Lloyd, quick update on that paper. I realized the official description says AttackVLA is a benchmark for evaluating adversarial and backdoor attacks on VLA models.
Got it. I'll update the note to reflect the 'VLA models' phrasing.
Thanks. Also, is it going to rain tomorrow? I want to know if I should bring an umbrella to work.
The forecast shows a 40% chance of light rain in the afternoon, so an umbrella might be wise.
Okay, I'll pack one. Just double-checking the AttackVLA definition for my report.
No problem. Let me know if you need any other definitions.
Will do. My coffee machine is leaking again, by the way.
That's annoying. Have you checked the seal on the reservoir?
